X1.evidence: Sec 3-4 (Experiments A and B): 40 independent qwen2.5-7B populations, per-call shuffling of option order against the published fixed order, and ten models run as real populations in a later comparison.

X2.evidence: Sec 4: first-listed option chosen 95-98% of the time under the published protocol; shuffling removes it; winning convention non-uniform across 40 runs (chi-square 22.0).

notes: Crossing between models and the option-order change is not documented for all eight models.
